top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear (26 TAC §747.4607(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A swing set at the operation did not have a use zone of at least 12 feet to the front and back of the structure.

top_violation_types.title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Sign in and out logs were not available for review during this inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1007(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A current CPR and First Aid needed for primary caregiver.  the cerificates on file expired.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver in a Registered Home Qualifications-Proof of Training in Required Topics (A-L) (26 TAC §747.1007(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider did not have documentation of all required trainings at time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not wash a child's hands after changing there diaper.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver went to wash the child's hands.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant in care did not have updated feeding instructions within the past thirty days.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.054 - Required Fees (26 TAC §HRC42.054 - Required Fees)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not paid background check fees.
